analysis: Independent binary logistic supervision achieved host validation macro HR@10 of 0.4775, improving on the reported sampled-softmax result of 0.4437 by 0.0338, while remaining 0.0275 below the reported original BCE baseline of 0.505. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.530, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.530, Electronics 0.305, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.545. Electronics remained at its reported sampled-softmax score of 0.305, so the objective change did not resolve that category's weakness. The controlled comparison supports logistic supervision for this architecture, but does not establish the proposed sparse-item learning mechanism. The comparison with the original baseline also includes architectural differences. No test results were available.
code_summary: Trains one independent HistoryModel per category from scratch with seed 42 and loads one best validation checkpoint per category. The network uses tied input/output item embeddings, positional embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks, and two learned attention-pooling heads with age decay. Last-position, mean, and pooled sequence features feed an MLP with a mean residual, LayerNorm, and normalized context output. Scores combine the context–item dot product, a clamped learned scale, and jointly trained item bias. The sole experimental change replaces sampled-softmax cross-entropy with positive softplus plus mean valid-negative softplus, averaged equally across examples. Invalid negatives contribute neither gradients nor denominator mass. Preserves 64 uniform negative draws, target/history exclusion, prefix sampling, AdamW, validation scheduling, early stopping, dataset routing, and predictor consistency checks. No ensembles or checkpoint averaging.
